text:
devin: Heads-up — planning to enable the scoped burst + queueing guardrails canary in us-east-1 tomorrow 09:30 PT. Putting the runbook and questions here. TL;DR: enable flag 'burst-scoped-v2' at 5% for Dedicated customers in us-east-1, enable queueing for non-urgent routes, set max_concurrency_guardrail=40. Who can +1 the scope and own the flip?

maria: +1 on canary scope (dedicated only). Quick ask: which metrics do we want on the dashboard? p50/p95/p99 latency, queue length, token/sec per GPU, and OOM rate? :eyes:

sanjay: yes to those. Add GPU util and accept-rate (requests accepted vs backpressured). Also define rollback thresholds: p99 > 1.5x baseline for 10m OR queue length > 500 for 5m => rollback.

emma: for canary audience, suggest tag-based targeting: {tier: "dedicated", region: "us-east-1", tag: "canary-burst-2026"}. Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 hours with 20m observation windows. If anything spikes, immediate rollback to previous flag state. I'm happy to own the monitoring during windows.

devin: perfect. sanjay can you paste the exact feature-flag payload we'll send to ff-service? ops will do the flip once we agree.

sanjay: snippet below (will post to /flags/burst-scoped-v2):
```json
{
  "flag": "burst-scoped-v2",
  "targeting": {
    "region": ["us-east-1"],
    "customer_tier": ["dedicated"],
    "tag": ["canary-burst-2026"]
  },
  "percent": 5,
  "params": {
    "enable_queueing": true,
    "max_concurrency_guardrail": 40,
    "burst_tokens": 500
  }
}
```

ops: I can flip at 09:30 PT. Need explicit checklist and who to ping for rollback. Also confirm if this affects hosted API customers at all.

emma: checklist: 1) create canary tag on 10 dedicated clusters (ops) 2) update dashboards and set alerts (maria + me) 3) run synthetic load tests (devin) 4) flip flag to 5% (ops) 5) monitor for 20m, then increase to 25% if stable. Rollback owner: ops (will flip off) + notify #incidents and product.

devin: hosted API unaffected — targeting filters exclude hosted. ops please confirm cluster list before flip. I'll run a quick synthetic script 20m prior to flip and post results here.

infra-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window available 09:00-10:00 PT. No conflicting deploys detected.

ops: Confirmed cluster list: ded-cluster-01..05 (us-east-1a) and ded-cluster-06..10 (us-east-1b). Will tag clusters at 08:45 PT.

maria: I'll update dashboards and create alert runbook:
- alert: burst_p99_exceeded
  condition: p99_request_latency > baseline*1.3 for 5m
  severity: page-on-call
- alert: queue_length_high
  condition: queue_length > 400 for 5m
  severity: page-on-call

sanjay: small QA: how does queueing interact with backpressure? We should add a metric for rejected requests (429 due to concurrency guardrail). Add rejected_count to dashboard.

emma: good call. Add 'rejected_count' and 'avg_wait_time' to the panel.

devin: final asks: who will run the post-canary smoke? I can run end-to-end prompts against the canary tag and post logs. Also who will create the experiment ticket for rollout tracking?

ops: I'll create the ticket and own the flip/rollback. devin will run smoke and post logs. emma + maria will monitor. sanjay will stand by for any infra fixes.

infra-bot: feature-flag scheduled: /flags/burst-scoped-v2 will be toggled at 1847583000 (09:30 PT). Trigger: ops.

devin: great — I'll post a quick prereq checklist at 08:30 PT and the smoke results at 09:10 PT. If nobody objects, we proceed with this plan. :thumbsup:

ops: no objections from me. Proceeding.

emma: :thumbsup: thanks everyone.

ops: post-note: after flip, if rejected_count > 50/min for 10m -> auto-rollback and page on-call.

infra-bot: Note: please update incident playbook link if you make changes: https://internal/playbooks/autoscale-guardrails
